Content settings control paragraph lines, list markers, emphasis, tables, and inline heading images

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import scrape, create_engine, CrawlConfig, ContentConfig

async def main() -> None:
    engine_config = CrawlConfig(
        content=ContentConfig(bullets="*", compact_tables=True, extract_metadata=False, keep_inline_images_in=["h2"], list_indent_width=4, strip_newlines=True, strong_em_symbol="_"),
    )
    engine = create_engine(engine_config)
    url = "https://example.com"
    result = await scrape(engine, url)
    print((result.markdown.content if result.markdown else None))

asyncio.run(main())
```
